review_boundary: Exact P32 source commit and reviewer-accessible result revision/materialized ref.

blocking.failure_mode: Unresolved owner/commit/publication boundary causes non-atomic or cross-owner behavior.
The frozen oracle is not sensitive to the known absent baseline capability.
Any one of the ten accepted high-impact failure modes remains untested or fails.
Results cannot be tied to exact subject, runner, oracle, profile, inputs, expected values or raw observations.
Build-only or mock evidence hides platform/adapter defects.
Container implementation regresses existing selection, connector, control, producer or snapshot behavior.
Independent reviewer cannot resolve the exact result/evidence boundary.

rules: Expected Unsupported is PASS only when all zero-mutation and receipt assertions also hold.
No green summary can replace case-level result and raw observation bindings.
No duplicate proof-of-proof chain; one real trace may satisfy multiple frozen obligations when its exact assertions are mapped.
No Gate verdict is issued by the execution result.
corroborative_only: Duplicate CI/local runs on the same subject and configuration.
Screenshots duplicating automated geometry or rendering observations.
Full-versus-incremental parity when both paths share the same production compiler.
Unbounded fuzzing, performance targets not accepted by Authority, and provenance-of-provenance.

deferred_to_other_gate.required_here: Explicit pre-write mixed-default-delete rejection only; full integrated behavior remains outside FC-08.
